machine: Snapdragon X Elite X1E80100 / Adreno X1-85, Windows ARM64
scope: Query work only; same authored snapshot in both arms, unchanged particles, constraint passes, contact ordering, damping, wake/sleep and offscreen simulation.

method.browser: Three sequential alternating original/optimized pairs, fresh hardware Edge per arm, fresh context per case, production simulation/camera/renderer, 1280x800 DPR1, 60 warmup frames, six measured seconds, normal 120Hz accumulator and 50ms elapsed cap, full GPU lighting and water, no adaptive quality or motion observer. Timing excludes React UI, audio, hardware input latency and asynchronous GPU completion.
method.stress: One 80-unit/sec horizontal impulse to each of the seven ropes at 70% material distance. Diagnostic stress, not a recorded complete route.
method.identity: 14 probes of 600 fixed 120Hz ticks each. Exact numeric state (including signed zero) and pose hashes; player, robot, rope position/stored velocity/bends every tick, poses every fourth tick. Object aliasing is deliberately excluded from the value comparison.
method.variability: Shared machine with variable background CPU load. Episode medians and all arms retained. FPS is not a guarantee for other machines, viewport sizes or background workloads.

validation.performanceRegression: Original code performs 100 distance roots for 100 out-of-range cached hints; optimized code performs zero. Exact corner ties, bounded radii, normal-directed contacts and geometry invalidation covered by existing exhaustive tests.
validation.browserGameplayChecks: 10 passed in hardware Edge: fresh 500/1300-unit keyboard climbs, swing/coast/release, reverse-gravity catching and turns, gate/window transfers, loose-ball contacts.
